question: Outside the proved class, where a cycle of three blocks makes a round-1 group of three: does filling each such cycle (the filled map) predict the growth class, does a kept cycle make the growth exponential or explosive, and does the explosive kind occur within five places? What does a sample of each kind typically show (A110)?

public_inputs.run: scripts/longrun.py launch job.py; python3 -B merge.py <out dir> <results.json>
public_inputs.reused: DOUBLE-IDENT machine_check (data, classify), joinlib engine; BREAK-EDDIES population_ref.json; the touch census

forbidden_inputs: Changing a population, the class rule, a prediction or the filled reading after reading the frozen run
primary_observable: X1, X1b, X2, X3 of research/EXPLOSIVE-20261119-001/preregistration.md, with the readouts
cheapest_meaningful_control: the census's 471 starts (explored), and the reference shapes (calibrated)

predictions.X1: filled b1 = 0 and decided: the filled reading equals the measured class
predictions.X1b: filled b1 >= 1 and decided: neither polynomial nor closing
predictions.X2: within five places (cap5, cycle5): no explosive start
predictions.X3: within seven places (cap7, fresh): at least one explosive start

stop_rule: One run; stop at the table, or at a size where the kind changes.
runtime: about half an hour on 16 workers
disclosed_exploration: the touch census's single- and multi-cycle starts (389 and 82, read before the freeze); smoke runs with seeds marked smoke; the calibration on the reference shapes (pilot/calibration.json)
